name: travel-cms
description: A blank template to get started with Payload 3.0

scripts.test: pnpm run test:int && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --no-experimental-strip-types" pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.scripts:help: echo '🚀 Travel CMS Scripts:' && echo '' && echo '📊 Quick Start:' && echo '  npm run import:trips     # Import trips from CSV' && echo '  npm run import:activities # Import activities via API' && echo '  npm run re-import:activities # Re-import specific trips' && echo '  npm run add:coordinates  # Add coordinates to activities' && echo '' && echo '🔧 Database:' && echo '  npm run update:categories # Update activity categories' && echo '  npm run add:coordinates  # Add coordinates with geocoding (original)' && echo '  npm run add:coordinates:optimized # Add coordinates (prevents duplicate API calls)' && echo '  npm run test:coordinates:optimized # Test 2 activities with optimization' && echo '' && echo '💡 Development:' && echo '  npm run dev              # Start development server' && echo '  npm run build            # Build for production' && echo '' && echo '📚 Help:' && echo '  npm run scripts:help    # Show this help'
